guidelines.title: Registration guidelines
guidelines.description: Prepare for DevFest Indore: KonfHub and LinkedIn details, entry ID, pass eligibility, workshop access and ticket policies.
guidelines.lead: A little preparation before you book. Everything you need to register, choose the right pass and arrive ready.
guidelines.supportText: For help with your registration or a question about attending, contact the GDG Indore organizers before the event.

partners.title: Build this edition with us.
partners.description: Meet the confirmed partners and collaborators of DevFest Indore 2026 and apply to contribute to this edition.
partners.lead: Technology, expertise and community. Meet the collaborators contributing to DevFest Indore 2026, and find your way to get involved.
partners.applicationText: Tell us what your organization would like to contribute. Share your ideas through the call-for-partners form so the organizing team can explore the right fit with you.

applicationPoints.title: Share your expertise
applicationPoints.text: Propose technical knowledge, developer demonstrations or practical learning experiences.

applicationPoints.title: Connect communities
applicationPoints.text: Bring a relevant developer community, industry network or outreach idea.

applicationPoints.title: Support the experience
applicationPoints.text: Discuss how your organization could support the event and its attendees.

partners.contactText: Have a question before applying? Email the organizing team.

venue.title: Plan your arrival.
venue.description: Find Essentia Luxury Hotel, the DevFest Indore 2026 venue, with directions, check-in information and an entry checklist.
venue.lead: Your route to a day of talks, ideas and community. Find the venue, prepare for check-in and get help before you travel.
venue.supportText: For accessibility, parking or other arrival questions, contact the organizers before you travel so we can help you plan.
